sections.Aims and Fit of Module: To introduce students to molecular modelling techniques using examples from inorganic and organic chemistry, and materials science.
sections.Learning outcomes: A Understand the importance of molecular modelling in chemistry and materials science. B Explain ab initio, semi-empirical and empirical models, knowing which model is suitable for a particular type of problem. C Explain Molecular Dynamics and Monte Carlo simulation methods, knowing which method is suitable for a particular type of problem. D Apply molecular/materials simulation techniques to solve chemistry and materials science problems. E Evaluate supportive technologies in modelling molecular and extended structure processes.
